name: Match record exports to report and replay
looks: A list of past matches with scores and checkmarks sits on the left. Two cards fan out from it: a formatted report document with a thumbnail of the board state, and a replay file icon, each labelled with its format.
build: variant-stack-reveal for the two export cards fanning out from the list's edge, each on a small seeded rotation that settles flat; the list rows above stagger in first on a quick 0.05s beat.
sound: A soft tick per list row, then a pop per export card landing.
prompt: Prove every result is backed by a record: show a short list of past runs with scores and checkmarks, then fan out two or three export formats from it, a readable report and a replayable file, each clearly labelled.
